item.title: Broken paving slabs, 19th August
item.description:
Because (a) Denberry Drive is so narrow and (b) cars normally park down on the east side of it, goods vehicles (and council dustcarts in particular) sometimes drive on the pavement on the west side. As the pavement has not been reinforced for this use, most of the paving slabs have been broken into small pieces. This not only looks unsightly, it also discourages walking on the pavement for fear of turning my ankle on an uneven, broken piece of paving. To avoid this, I always walk in the road. I would like to suggest that all the paving slabs on the west side are relayed after the footway has been reinforced so as to take the council's dustcarts and other heavy vehicles without damage to the slabs. It is evident that the problem has persisted for many years as so many slabs have broken into small pieces.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 15, Denberry Drive, Albany Park, Sidcup, Greater London
